name: Six Senses Krabey Island
positioning: Private-island resort of free-standing pool villas off Ream National Park in the Gulf of Thailand
best_for: Travelers who want a secluded private-island stay with their own pool villa
Spa-focused travelers interested in Khmer and Cambodian healing treatments

facts.text: The resort is a private island 5 kilometers off Ream National Park in the Gulf of Thailand in southern Cambodia.
All accommodation is in private free-standing pool villas that blend into the canopy of trees.
The villas have green living roofs and make maximum use of daylight.
The villas follow the Sleep With Six Senses standard.
The spa offers traditional Khmer massage and Cambodian healing treatments.
Spa design and treatments are inspired by the sacred Kbal Spean River.
Tree Restaurant serves a modern twist on traditional Khmer cuisine, with a focus on local and seasonal produce.
Through sustainable planning the resort blends into the natural vegetation, which has become a haven for birds and butterflies.
Experiences range from action-packed adventures to leisurely pursuits.

highlights.text: Every villa is a private free-standing pool villa set into the island's tree canopy.
A private island 5 kilometers off Ream National Park in the Gulf of Thailand.

considerations.text: The resort is on its own private island off Ream National Park, in the Gulf of Thailand off southern Cambodia.
